description: List the CRM's open advertising recommendations across every channel: kind (spend_no_result, unanswered_leads, low_roas, scale_winner, cost_per_lead_spike), severity (urgent, warning, opportunity), the campaign and the frozen evidence the rule saw. They are deterministic rules over data only the CRM has — whether a click became a customer, what it paid, whether anyone replied — not a model's opinion. Snoozed and handled ones are not listed. Read-only; deciding a recommendation is done on the Ads page. Takes no arguments. Use list_ad_campaigns for the figures behind a card and list_conversations for the unanswered enquiries.
name: list_ad_recommendations
title: List ad recommendations
